strings.shell.screenNotBuilt: This screen is specified by {leaves}. Its package has not been merged yet.
strings.shell.readOnly: Nothing to do here in this phase. {reason}
strings.shell.noGameNow: No game now. The Game hub opens on game day.

strings.palette.title: Go to

strings.help.title: Help: {title}
strings.help.screen.office.today: What needs the head coach today: hours left, the day's schedule and what is waiting.
strings.help.screen.office.inbox: Every message and decision that needs you, most urgent first.
strings.help.screen.office.calendar: The football calendar, its phases and deadlines, and the control to advance time.
strings.help.screen.team.roster: Everyone under contract, with position, status and the staff's estimates.
strings.help.screen.team.depth_chart: Who starts and who backs up at every position and in every package.
strings.help.screen.team.player: One player: grades as your staff estimate them, performance, knowledge, health and the person.
strings.help.screen.team.health: Who is hurt, who is limited, and what the medical staff advise.
strings.help.screen.team.roster_moves: Signings, releases, the practice squad and the weekly active list, within the rules.
strings.help.screen.team.draft: The draft board your scouts built, and the picks you hold.
strings.help.screen.team.free_agency: Free agents, trade talks and offers, by the power arrangement with the general manager.
strings.help.screen.team.cap: Contracts, cap space and the cost of every move.
strings.help.screen.football.playbook: Every play and call in the book, sorted into series.
strings.help.screen.football.play_designer: Draw and test offensive plays assignment by assignment.
strings.help.screen.football.defense_designer: Build fronts, pressures, coverages and checks into calls.
strings.help.screen.football.install: What gets taught when, and how ready the players are.
strings.help.screen.football.game_plan: This week's plan: the menu by situation and the matchups to attack.
strings.help.screen.football.call_sheet: Lay out the sheet you carry on game day, and the opening script.
strings.help.screen.football.print: Print or export the sheet, wristbands and plan.
strings.help.screen.football.self_scout: Your own tendencies, as an opponent's staff would chart them.
strings.help.screen.week.schedule: The days of this week and what fills each one.
strings.help.screen.week.practice: Periods, scripts, scout looks and reps for each practice.
strings.help.screen.week.meetings: Staff, team and position meetings for the week.
strings.help.screen.week.scouting_report: The opponent's tendencies from logged plays, and the staff's report.
strings.help.screen.week.documents: The documents a game week produces: itinerary, reports and lists.
strings.help.screen.game.pregame: Warmups, inactives, the coin toss and the last word before kickoff.
strings.help.screen.game.console: The sideline: the call sheet, the field, the clock and the booth.
strings.help.screen.game.halftime: Halftime adjustments and the talk, inside the halftime clock.
strings.help.screen.game.postgame: After the final whistle: the locker room, the press and the first look at the film.
strings.help.screen.film.viewer: Watch any play from any angle with overlays.
strings.help.screen.film.cutups: Cut-ups of plays by tag, for study and teaching.
strings.help.screen.film.grades: Player grades and corrections from the film.
strings.help.screen.film.decision_log: Every decision you made, with the situation and what followed.
strings.help.screen.film.statistics: Statistics and analytics for your team and the league.
strings.help.screen.film.tagging: Tag plays for the staff's breakdown.
strings.help.screen.people.staff: Your staff, what each coach does and how they work.
strings.help.screen.people.coach: One coach on your staff or another: record, habits and history.
strings.help.screen.people.delegation: Which jobs your assistants carry, play calling included.
strings.help.screen.people.locker_room: Leaders, groups and the mood of the team.
strings.help.screen.people.meeting: Talk with a player, coach or boss.
strings.help.screen.people.owner: Your owner or athletic director and general manager: expectations and standing.
strings.help.screen.people.media: Press conferences, interviews and what is being written.
strings.help.screen.people.player_designer: Design a player by archetype, measurables or a blank sheet, with plausibility checks.
strings.help.screen.league.schedule: Every game in the league, with results.
strings.help.screen.league.team: Another team: roster, staff, record and tendencies seen.
strings.help.screen.league.transactions: Every signing, trade and release in the league.
strings.help.screen.league.records: Awards, records and the league's history.
strings.help.screen.league.legends: The league's people, teams, eras and rivalries, and the season chronicle.
strings.help.screen.coach.career: Your career so far and how you are seen.
strings.help.screen.coach.contract: Your own contract: years, pay, buyout and clauses.
strings.help.screen.coach.finance: Your money: income, spending and investments.
strings.help.screen.coach.notebook: Your notes, and what you said against what you did (E11.4.1).
strings.help.screen.coach.life: Your hours, energy, health and family.
strings.help.screen.coach.job_market: Open jobs, interest in you and offers.
strings.help.screen.coach.record: Your record of work: what you did, not a score.
strings.help.screen.school.lessons: Lessons on real coaching, outside any career game.
strings.help.screen.school.glossary: Every football term the game uses, with its definition.
strings.help.screen.school.drills: Practice tools where time can be slowed or paused.
strings.help.screen.school.mods: Install, check and remove mods, and edit plays, formations and people.
strings.help.screen.school.settings: Display, audio, controls, playback, accessibility, data and mods.
